reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

flags.reason: misreads-source: The main child is marked alwaysPresent=false, but the guide says it "establishes the size and the visual object people identify first". It is present in both the "Badge present" and "Badge absent" states. Only the badge is optional.

notes: /examples/0 says the main IconCapsule is 'at its default size' and leaves out a size mode. The cited sources sentence says the guide uses Icon Capsule Size M for the main child. If IconCapsule's default is not M, the example misstates the guide; check this against the package. The 'default bottom-right anchor' claim and the circular=true / false mapping to Circle edge / Bounding box are package facts and were not judged here. /configuration/6 turns the guide's own sizing choice into general advice. The evidence supports that advice (a style override bypasses the native radius), so it is not flagged.
